1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 Bb4 5.ex.strategy: The bishop is attacked by the queen, so it takes the knight first. Black can only recapture with the g-pawn, which leaves doubled f-pawns and an isolated h-pawn. White gives up the bishop pair for that, so White has to show the damaged pawns are worth more than Black's active pieces.

The only recapture, since the queen cannot reach f6. Black accepts doubled f-pawns and an isolated h-pawn, but gets the bishop pair, a half-open g-file and a centralised queen. White plays for a lasting pawn weakness, Black for piece activity.
